excerpt: Titan is a New York wealth management firm for tech professionals, pairing clients with human advisors for equity compensation, tax and investment planning.
content:
Titan is a US registered investment adviser that manages money for tech workers. Each client gets a dedicated human wealth advisor, and Titan handles investment management, equity compensation planning (stock options and RSUs), tax planning, financial planning and retirement. Its homepage says it manages $1.2 billion for more than 10,000 clients as of 30 September 2026, and that it was founded in 2017. Its about page lists Joe Percoco (co-CEO and cofounder) and Clay Gardner (co-CEO and chief investment officer).

Percoco and Gardner founded Titan in 2017, TechCrunch reported, and it began as a retail investment management platform aimed at millennials. In February 2021 it raised a $12.5 million Series A led by General Catalyst, with Sound Ventures, BoxGroup and Y Combinator among the other investors, and later that year it moved from the titanvest.com domain to titan.com. In August 2023 the US Securities and Exchange Commission charged Titan Global Capital Management with misleading advertising of hypothetical performance, including annualised returns as high as 2,700% for its crypto strategy, the first case under the SEC's amended marketing rule. Without admitting or denying the findings, Titan agreed to a censure and to pay $192,454 in disgorgement and prejudgment interest and an $850,000 civil penalty.

Titan does not show a fee schedule on its homepage; its FAQ answers questions about fees, and prospective clients speak with an advisor first. It is aimed at tech professionals with equity compensation rather than first-time investors with small balances.

We have not used Titan for this page. It brings together Titan's own website and the reporting linked under Sources, and says where each fact comes from. Nothing here is paid placement.
